items.title: The after-hours receptionist
items.one_liner: An AI voice agent answers after-hours calls, books the appointment on your real calendar, and texts you the details — urgent calls flagged for a callback now.

items.title: Ask for a review at the perfect moment
items.one_liner: AI triggers a review request right after a happy customer interaction, then drafts a thoughtful reply to every review that comes in.

items.title: Remind customers before the job, rebook them after
items.one_liner: Each scheduled job triggers a reminder with prep details the day before, then a thank-you and a rebooking nudge a few days after.

items.title: Build a 30-day content calendar in one click
items.one_liner: AI plans a full month of posts — hooks, captions, hashtags — ready for you to approve and schedule.

items.title: Deflect common FAQs with an AI chat widget
items.one_liner: Trained on your own docs and pricing, it answers instantly and only escalates the genuinely hard questions to a human.

items.title: Draft a reply to every inbound message
items.one_liner: AI suggests an on-brand response to each email, DM, and review so your team approves in one click instead of writing from scratch.

items.title: Enrich every new lead automatically
items.one_liner: AI looks up company size, industry, and tech stack the moment a lead comes in, so reps walk into every call informed.

items.title: Turn finished-job photos into ready-to-review posts
items.one_liner: Drop in photos and a two-line job note, and AI drafts a local-flavored post for your Google profile and social pages for you to approve.

items.title: Generate a page for every city you serve
items.one_liner: AI drafts location pages with local keywords, FAQs, and schema so you rank in neighboring towns you've been invisible in.

items.title: Get a Monday-morning performance digest
items.one_liner: AI pulls your ad, analytics, and CRM numbers into a plain-English summary in your inbox every week — zero spreadsheets.

items.title: Inbox triage
items.one_liner: Tags every incoming email, pulls the customer’s history, and drafts ready-to-send replies to the routine ones — while complaints and billing come straight to you.

items.title: Keep your Google Business Profile fresh
items.one_liner: AI drafts weekly GBP posts and Q&A answers that nudge your local-pack ranking up without you lifting a finger.

items.title: The lead chaser
items.one_liner: Watches your inbox or CRM for quotes that went quiet and drafts one short, personal follow-up that offers two times to talk — then stops the moment they reply.

items.title: Localize one offer for 20 towns
items.one_liner: AI rewrites a single landing page for each market you serve, with the right city and neighborhood language.

items.title: The Monday expense report
items.one_liner: Forward every receipt to one address; each Monday you get a one-page report — spend by category, unmatched items, and anything unusual — clean data for your bookkeeper.

items.title: Write your monthly customer email from a few bullet notes
items.one_liner: Jot down what happened this month, and the AI turns it into a short, on-brand email draft that's waiting in your inbox to review and send.

items.title: Qualify leads while you sleep
items.one_liner: A website chat agent talks to after-hours visitors, scores them, and drops the hot ones straight onto your calendar.

items.title: Turn every quote request into a draft estimate by morning
items.one_liner: A quote form comes in, the AI checks it against your price list and drafts the estimate and cover email, and you review and send it.

items.title: Spin up an ad campaign from your website
items.one_liner: AI reads your site and drafts Google and Meta ad copy, target audiences, and a starting budget plan.

items.title: Text back every missed call within a minute
items.one_liner: When a call goes unanswered, the caller gets a friendly text right away asking what they need, and you get the reply with a suggested next step.

items.title: Turn one blog post into 10 social posts
items.one_liner: AI repurposes a single article into a week of captions, carousels, and short-form video scripts in your brand voice.

items.title: Turn voicemails into tasks
items.one_liner: AI transcribes each voicemail, summarizes what the caller needs, and creates a follow-up task automatically.

items.title: Win back customers who haven't booked in a while
items.one_liner: AI finds customers whose last service was long enough ago to be due again and drafts a personal check-in for each segment.

items.title: Write first-draft proposals in minutes
items.one_liner: AI assembles a tailored proposal from your templates plus the prospect's details, so you edit instead of start from zero.
